findings.title: The new table visualization receives no query results
findings.body: When `use-table-widget-visualization` is enabled, this branch passes `columns: []` and an empty `tableData` instead of the current `result`'s fields, metadata, and rows. Dashboard table widgets therefore render blank for organizations using the new visualization, even when the query returned data.

findings.title: Zero-valued age or timestamp bypasses mutual-exclusion validation
findings.body: These validators use truthiness to check whether the other field was supplied. Since `timestamp=0` and `age=0` are valid values, a report containing both fields is accepted whenever the field checked by `get()` is zero. Check field presence instead so the endpoint consistently rejects reports containing both.

findings.title: All replay errors are appended to every paginated segment result
findings.body: The paginator invokes `on_results` for each page of recording segments, but this callback receives the complete replay's `error_events` list on every invocation. `gen_request_data` emits every error left after processing the page's segments, so errors are repeated across pages and summaries for a page can include errors outside that page's time range.
